bio_full_text:
Ashish Labroo
Business Head, BorderPlus  |  Transforming Global Skilling
Ashish Labroo is Business Head at BorderPlus, an AI-native healthcare workforce mobility platform that 
prepares and places Indian nurses and healthcare professionals in Germany and the GCC. Since joining in 
February 2025, he has led BorderPlus's India business and is driving its expansion into new international 
corridors, including the GCC and Japan.
BorderPlus operates on a Source–Train–Place–Integrate model: identifying qualified healthcare talent 
across India, training candidates in language, clinical and cultural readiness, placing them with employers 
abroad, and supporting their integration after arrival. Ashish has built the company's government 
relations, franchise and partnership network, working with state governments and skilling institutions to 
create structured, ethical migration pathways for Indian care workers.
Ashish brings a career of nearly two decades in revenue, growth and P&L leadership across hospitality, 
telecom, financial services and technology. He spent over five years at OYO, rising from Revenue Head for 
Western India and Hub Head for Mumbai and Gujarat to building OYO360 across India and Southeast Asia, 
leading National Supply Acquisition, and finally heading Supply Strategy, Revenue and Margins for OYO 
India. He then served as Vice President, Enterprise Solutions at Reliance Jio.
Earlier, as Associate Vice President, Strategic Alliances at HDFC Life, he led the Emerging and Digital 
Alliances   team   across   fintech,   edtech,   mobility,   payments   and   telecom,   building   new   digital-first 
distribution channels for life insurance and first-of-their-kind partnerships with companies such as Uber 
and Airtel. He spent more than six years at Bharti Airtel, joining through its Young Leader programme and 
rising to DGM and Head of Prepaid for Tamil Nadu, with responsibility for voice, data and VAS revenue, 
customer usage, retention and acquisition, along with an earlier stint building distribution for Airtel 
Money in Mumbai. He began his career as a design engineer at STMicroelectronics, developing electronic 
design automation tools.
His work today sits at the heart of the global care economy. As demand for nurses, eldercare and allied 
care workers grows across Europe, the Middle East and East Asia, Ashish focuses on what it takes to make 
Indian care talent globally portable: training aligned to destination-country occupational standards and 
international   certifications,   sustained   language   proficiency,   soft   skills   and   cultural   readiness,   and 
structured overseas placement pathways that turn opportunities abroad into lasting careers.
Ashish holds an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad, including an exchange term 
at ESSEC Business School, and a bachelor's degree from Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology 
(NIT) Jalandhar. He is based in Mumbai.

Dr. Madhuri Dubey is the Founder-Director of National Skills Network (NSN), a knowledge and 
capacity-building platform focused on strengthening the education–employability–skills 
ecosystem through applied learning, work-integrated learning, research, communication and 
capacity-building initiatives. 
With over a decade of work through NSN, Madhuri has worked with diverse stakeholders across 
higher education, vocational education, industry, government and international development 
organisations. Her work focuses on connecting education with the world of work and 
helping institutions translate ideas around skills, employability and applied learning into 
practice. 
Areas of expertise 
• Applied Learning, work-integrated learning and employability 
• Curriculum design and skill integration in academic programmes 
• Faculty development and capacity-building 
• Designing and facilitating workshops, webinars and sensitisation programmes 
• Human skills and employability in the age of AI 
• Communication, content development and digital outreach 
• Research and knowledge development in education and skills 
Madhuri brings 28 years of experience across communication, training, curriculum design, 
technology-enabled learning and marketing. Her professional journey includes work with 
organisations in enterprise e-learning and marketing communications, as well as initiatives with 
government and private-sector organisations in vocational training, e-learning and digital 
marketing. 
Her academic background includes doctoral research in Education Policy and Curriculum 
Studies in ESL from the English and Foreign Languages University (EFLU), Hyderabad, 
giving her a distinctive perspective that combines academic inquiry with practical experience in 
education, skills and employability. She is also the author of Effective E-learning – Design, 
Development and Delivery, published in 2011. 
Through NSN she has contributed to collaborative projects with Indian and international 
institutions in areas including applied learning, graduate employability, curriculum development 
and capacity building.

bio: Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Gupta, ISS, is the Chief Executive Officer of the Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM), with over 27 years of experience across government, entrepreneurship, and the technology industry. A topper of the 1998 Indian Statistical Service batch, he served in key roles in the Government of India before moving into leadership positions at IBM, Accenture, and Microsoft. As India advances towards a USD 1 trillion digital economy, Karnataka is playing a pivotal role by leveraging 
its  leadership  in  technology,  innovation,  and  digital  infrastructure.  At  the  forefront  of  this  transformation  is    
Mr.  Sanjeev  Kumar  Gupta,  Chief  Executive  Officer  of  the  Karnataka  Digital  Economy  Mission  (KDEM),  an 
initiative of the Government of Karnataka dedicated to accelerating the state's digital economy. 
 
With  over  27  years  of  experience  spanning  government,  entrepreneurship,  and  the  technology  industry,           
Mr. Gupta has built a distinguished career as an administrator, business leader, mentor, and catalyst for India's 
IT  growth.  Under  his  leadership,  KDEM  is  driving  strategic  initiatives  across  Global  Capability  Centres 
(GCCs),  IT/ITES,  Innovation  &  Startups,  Electronics  System  Design  and  Manufacturing  (ESDM),  Beyond 
Bengaluru,  and  Talent  Acceleration,  positioning  Karnataka  to  contribute  the  largest  share  towards  the  Hon'ble 
Prime Minister's vision of a USD 1 trillion digital economy. 
 
CAREER JOURNEY:  
 
Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Gupta's leadership journey began in public service.  A topper of  the 1998  Indian  Statistical 
Service (ISS) batch, he spent a decade in the Government of India, serving as Director and Deputy Secretary in 
the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation and the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. During this 
period, he played a pivotal role in establishing the Special Secretariat Service (SSS) cadre, strengthening national 
health programmes such as NRHM and RCH Phase II, and setting up the National Health Systems Resource 
Centre (NHSRC). 
 
Building on this strong policy foundation, Mr. Gupta transitioned to the private sector, where he held leadership 
roles at IBM, Accenture, and Microsoft. Across these global technology companies, he led initiatives in digital 
transformation,   public   sector   consulting,   enterprise   strategy,   and   technology-enabled governance,   gaining 
extensive experience at the intersection of policy, business, and innovation. 
 
In 2018,  he  became Managing  Director  &  CEO  of  Lahari,  a  Government  of  India-promoted Electronics 
System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) cluster in Mysuru. There, he successfully built and scaled thriving 
electronics manufacturing ecosystem, demonstrating his ability to create institutions and foster industry-led growth. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Leading Karnataka's Digital Economy 
 
Since 2022, Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Gupta has been serving as the Chief Executive Officer of the Karnataka Digital 
Economy Mission (KDEM), working closely with the Department of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T, Government 
of  Karnataka,  industry  leaders,  startups,  and  global  investors.  Under  his  leadership,  KDEM  continues  to  drive 
Karnataka's  digital  economy  through  strategic  initiatives  in Global  Capability  Centres  (GCCs),  IT/ITES, 
Innovation & Startups, Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM), Talent Acceleration, and the 
Beyond Bengaluru initiative, strengthening the state's leadership in India's digital economy while expanding growth 
across emerging technology clusters.

public administration and India's digital economy growth

(2005–2007) 
• Bachelor of Science (Honours), Statistics — Banaras Hindu University (1990–1993) 
• Lean Six Sigma Black Belt 
AWARDS & RECOGNITION: 
• Featured in ET Edge's 40 Under 40 for leadership in advancing Karnataka's digital economy. 
• Recognised at Bengaluru Tech Summit (BTS) for driving Karnataka's digital economy across GCCs, 
startups, ESDM, and innovation. 
• Recognised for contributing to India's IT growth through 27+ years of leadership across government, 
global technology, and entrepreneurship. 
  
LEADERSHIP & AFFILIATIONS: 
 
Mr. Gupta serves on several boards, advisory panels, and governing councils across both the government and 
private sector.

Mr. Gupta cherishes time with his family as a devoted father of two and is a poet at heart.

name: Arun Yogiraj
bio: Dr. Arun Yogiraj is one of India’s renowned sculptors, representing five generations of Mysore’s traditional sculpting heritage. With an MBA from the University of Mysore, he returned to sculpting in 2008 after a brief corporate career. His notable creations include the Ram Lalla idol at Ayodhya’s Ram Mandir, Adi Shankaracharya statue at Kedarnath, Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose statue at India Gate, Nandi at Amarnath, and major works for ISRO and heritage institutions. His sculptures combine traditional Indian aesthetics, realism, spirituality, and intricate craftsmanship. He has received numerous national, state, and international awards and continues to contribute to India’s sculptural heritage.

bio:

year tenure in the IT sector, marked by notable achievements in strategic leadership roles

Master's in Management from IMI, Delhi. Additionally, she is certified by the Indian Institute 
of Corporate Affairs and is listed in the Independent Directors Data Bank maintained by the 
Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

bio:
Dr. Nidhi Pundhir is an international humanitarian services and socio-economic-environmental development specialist. In the capacity of Senior Vice President, Global CSR, she leads the global CSR agenda for HCLTech and heads the HCLFoundation, which is the CSR arm of HCLTech, in India.  

Dr. Pundhir has strategized as well as executed impactful programmatic frameworks that are aligned to the global Sustainable Development Goals, for the most disadvantaged and isolated communities, including environmental targets. She has built the HCLFoundation’s vision, mission, and strategy to the next level, ensuring high-quality programme delivery, that brings about meaningful difference on ground. 

With more than 27 years of experience in actualizing Human Rights and Environmental action at national and international levels, some of the key portfolios she has held were with SOS Children’s Villages as Director Programme Development, Asia, and at Plan International’s International Headquarters as Global Advisor on Child Protection in Development. 

Dr. Pundhir holds a doctorate in Public Health Management, with her thesis on “Right to Health During First 1000 Days of Life for Children Living in Slums”, from IIHMR University, Jaipur and an M.Phil. in Health Systems Management from BITS, Pilani, India.

name: Subroto Bagchi
company: Vision Group for Skill Development, Govt. of Karnataka
bio:
Subroto Bagchi is an entrepreneur, author and public servant. 

Bagchi spent four decades with the Indian IT industry where he is best known as a co-founder of Mindtree. Mindtree (now LTIMindtree) was one of India’s most admired software companies that built the AADHAR platform among its many other contributions. In 2019, Mindtree revenues exceeded US $1 billion with 20,000 employees globally. Bagchi started at Mindtree as Chief Operating Officer in 1999 and rose to become Executive Chairman before stepping down in 2016 when he moved to public service. 

Bagchi is a well-known writer with best-sellers like The High-Performance Entrepreneur, Go Kiss the World, The Professional, MBA at 16, The Elephant Catchers and SELL. His last book SELL received the CK Prahalad Award for the best business book of 2018. His books have been translated in many major Indian languages as well as Chinese and Korean. 

As a public servant, his last assignment was Chief Advisor to Government of Odisha for Institutional Capacity Building. Prior to this, he was Chairman of Odisha Skill Development Authority where his charter was to create employable skills for youth of Odisha through short and long-term skill building. Under his leadership, the State witnessed massive transformation of the ITI and Polytechnics as well as scaling up of short-term skill development. His largest contribution has been the setting up of the iconic World Skill Center in Bhubaneswar. The Government of Odisha accorded him with the rank and status of cabinet minister. He took a salary of 1 Rupee per year from the Government for his eight years of service from 2016 to 2024. 

Bagchi has been inducted into the Order of Engineers by the University of Florida and honoured for his contributions in Management and Information Technology by the Utkal University with an Honorary Doctorate in Literature and by the Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology with an Honorary Doctorate in Science. 

Bagchi has served the boards of IIM Bengaluru, Indian Oil, IIIT Bhubaneswar and the Software Technology Parks of India. He and his writer wife Susmita, support the cause for prevention of blindness, geriatric care, cancer, and mental health among other issues towards which they have pledged substantial personal wealth and time. Their efforts have led to the setting up of the Bagchi-Parthasarathy Hospital at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, the Bagchi-Sri Shankara Cancer Hospital & Research Centre in Bhubaneswar, and the Bagchi-Karunashraya Centre for Palliative Care in Bhubaneswar and The Bagchi School of Public Health at the Ahmedabad University.

name: Alina Alam
bio: Alina Alam is a social entrepreneur, disability inclusion advocate, and the Founder-CEO of Mitti Café, an organisation working to create economic independence, dignity, and equal opportunities for persons with disabilities. She founded Mitti Café at the age of 23, driven by a vision to showcase the abilities and potential of individuals with disabilities and create workplaces where inclusion is embedded in everyday life. Alina holds a B.A. in Psychology from Sophia College for Women, Mumbai, and a Master’s degree in Development Studies from Azim Premji University, Bengaluru. Her academic background in psychology and development studies has strongly shaped her approach to social entrepreneurship, community development, and inclusive employment. Under her leadership, Mitti Café has grown from a single table under an umbrella into a nationally recognised social enterprise, with cafés operating across India, including at prestigious institutions such as the Supreme Court of India, Rashtrapati Bhavan, airports, universities, and corporate spaces. The organisation has created thousands of livelihood opportunities for persons with disabilities and also runs outreach initiatives promoting disability awareness, inclusion, and rights. Alina is a four-time TEDx speaker and has been recognised on the Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia list. Her work has received national and international recognition, including the National Award for the Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (2024), presented by the President of India, the Commonwealth Youth Award, NITI Aayog’s Women Transforming India Award, United Nations Intercultural Innovation Award, Helen Keller Award, and several other honours for social entrepreneurship and disability inclusion. Her areas of interest include disability inclusion, inclusive employment, social entrepreneurship, community development, accessibility, youth leadership, and building sustainable models for social impact. Through her work, Alina seeks to challenge conventional perceptions of disability and inspire a more equitable and inclusive society.

name: Gururaj ‘Desh’ Deshpande
bio:
Dr. Gururaj "Desh" Deshpande is a renowned Indian-American entrepreneur, philanthropist, and ecosystem builder. Over a four-decade entrepreneurial career, he has founded and chaired several major technology companies, including Cascade Communications (which routed over 80% of internet traffic in the 1990s), Sycamore Networks, and Tejas Networks. He also co-chaired US President Obama’s National Council on Innovation and Entrepreneurship. Desh serves as a Life Member of the MIT Corporation, where he established the Deshpande Center for Technological Innovation. 

 

Alongside his wife, Jaishree, Desh launched the Deshpande Foundation to co-create scalable models for social transformation across India, the United States, and Canada. In 2007, the couple established the Deshpande Centre for Social Innovation in their hometown of Hubballi in north Karnataka. Through this ecosystem, they have supported more than 521 startups, generated over ₹1,061 crore in cumulative revenue, built 15,000 farm ponds for dryland farmers and trained 26,000+ disadvantaged youth - achieving an 80% formal employment rate. Additionally, their primary education program nurtures over 40,000 children across 600 rural schools with essential life skills. The Foundation now drives systemic change by partnering with public universities to embed employability skills directly into higher education.

name: Arati Hiremath
bio:
Arati Hiremath has been into business for the past 36 years. She floated Artikrafts in the year 1990. Arati Hiremath is an exponent of Kasuti embroidery. She started reviving Kasuti when it was almost a languishing craft. She has experimented with its application on different wearables and home décor and has made it a popular Indian embroidery. She markets it throughout the world through her Facebook and Instagram pages and her website, www.artikrafts.in. She has a studio in Dharwad and has formed a formidable customer base.

She also engages in training programmes and helps students and scholars in their research on Kasuti. So far, she has trained hundreds of women in the craft of Kasuti embroidery. She has more than 200 artisans working for Artikrafts.

She has attended various exhibitions, but the feather in the cap was exhibiting at the G20 Finance Summit in Bengaluru. Amongst her known customers is Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman, the Hon. Minister of Finance, who wore an Artikrafts creation to present the 2023 Budget and another one to her daughter’s wedding.

She has also created a shalya which was presented to Hon. Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi during the inauguration of the National Youth Festival held at Hubli.

She was presented an award for her work in the field of crafts by Sri Sathya Sai University of Human Excellence. She was among seven women from all over India to be honoured with this award.

She is happily married to Praveen Hiremath, an engineer by profession, who is into business.

Her daughter, Tanushree, and son-in-law are dental surgeons in Mumbai.

Her son, Shivharan, is a businessman.

name: N.S. Parthasarathy
bio:
Parthasarathy NS (Partha) is a seasoned entrepreneur, investor, and technology leader with a distinguished career spanning over four decades in the global IT industry. As the co-founder, COO, and Executive Vice-Chairperson of Mindtree, he played a pivotal role in transforming the company from a VC-funded startup in 1999 to a billion-dollar enterprise by 2019.

Partha’s expertise lies in scaling technology businesses, executing successful M&A strategies, and fostering high-performance, high-caring organizational cultures. His leadership was instrumental in establishing Mindtree’s globally recognized learning center in Bhubaneswar—designed around the principles of Curiosity, Courage, and Responsibility, setting new benchmarks in talent development.

An angel investor and mentor, Partha actively supports startups in technology, strategy, organizational culture, and enterprise sales. He has personally invested in several startups and is a limited partner in funds such as Inventus and TVS Capital. His passion for nurturing sustainable businesses is encapsulated in his belief:

“We started off with a very simple goal—to help people create 10 more Mindtrees. If we achieve even a part of that, it will be a legacy worth leaving behind.”

A recipient of the Distinguished Alumnus Award from BITS Pilani, Partha holds an M.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Kharagpur and has completed the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School. Beyond his corporate achievements, he is a passionate marathoner and an active member of various social impact initiatives, including the India Amateur Runners Trust and WeLive Foundation.

name: Mohan Lakhamraju
bio:
Mohan Lakhamraju is a prominent entrepreneur, visionary education leader, and the Founder and CEO of Great Learning. He also serves as the Chairman of the Great Lakes Institute of Management. A strong advocate for continuous upskilling, Mohan has long recognized the cultural shift toward lifelong learning and has dedicated his career to delivering high-quality, transformational education to millions of professionals worldwide. 

Mohan holds a stellar academic pedigree, having earned his B.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Bombay, followed by a Master's in Computer Science from the University of California, Berkeley. A recipient of the prestigious David Packard Fellowship, he went on to complete his MBA at the Stanford Graduate School of Business. 

Before entering the ed-tech space, he spent a decade in Silicon Valley, first as an entrepreneur helping build Stratify (a SaaS company, now part of HP). He then moved into venture capital as an investor at Draper Fisher Jurvetson (DFJ), before going on to serve as Managing Director for Tiger Global in India, where he led the firm's investment activities across high-potential ventures in India and other emerging markets. As Chairman of the Great Lakes Institute of Management, Mohan spearheads the growth strategy and new initiatives. He has been associated with Great Lakes since 2011 and helped expand its range of offerings into new geographies, new executive programs, and technology-enabled online and blended learning programs. 

In 2013, Mohan co-founded Great Learning with a mission to deliver high-quality, blended learning outcomes. Under his leadership, the bootstrapped startup has grown into a leading global online higher education platform, delivering over 500 million hours of impactful learning to more than 15 million professionals across 170+ countries. He has also driven the growth of the Great Lakes Institute of Management as its Chairman — spearheading the establishment of its Gurgaon campus, guiding it to a top-10 ranking among private business schools in India, and leading it to become the youngest business school in the country to earn AMBA (UK) accreditation. Great Lakes today counts an alumni network of over 25,000 professionals across 30+ countries. 

Mohan's contributions to business and education have earned wide recognition, including 'Transformative Edtech Leader' at the TechEdu India Awards 2026, organised by ET Education; 'Entrepreneur of the Year 2025' at the ET Entrepreneur Awards by The Economic Times; 'the Distinguished Alumni Award (2023)' from IIT Bombay; 'EdTech CEO of the Year (2020)' from EdTechReview; and the P. N. Singh Memorial Award (2015) for 'Outstanding Academic Leadership' by the Higher Education Forum.

bio:
Devashish leads the Corporate Relations function at Diageo India and is a member of its Executive Committee and the Global Corporate Relations Leadership team. His responsibilities include driving policy advocacy across Regulatory, Tax and Trade related matters, Market Access, Corporate Reputation & Communications and delivering Social Impact in line with the Diageo’s Spirit of Progress ESG action plan.

Devashish has almost three decades of experience across diverse sectors including FMCG, Food Service, Information Technology, Infrastructure, Media and Automobiles. His experience includes government affairs, policy advocacy, sustainability and CSR.

partnership  with  government,  not  by  LAHI  alone,  now  reaching  20+  states  and  over  2  million 
students  a  year.  Along  the  way:  a  Chevening  Gurukul  Scholarship,  a  Government  of  India 
appointment to the National Skill Development Agency, a seat on NCERT's textbook development 
team  under  NEP  2020, a  President's  Volunteer Service  Award, "top  alumnus"  honors from  UT 
Austin  (MBA  included,  presumably  as  a  backup  plan),  and  an  Electronics  Engineering  degree

name: R.
bio:
Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, popularly known as Dr. Balu, is a widely respected development practitioner, leadership trainer, author, and public policy expert. He also serves as Chairperson of the Social Stock Exchange Advisory Committee of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). He brings to this role a rare blend of grassroots and macro perspectives, drawn from nearly four decades of multifaceted experience in development and public policy. 

Dr. Balu is widely recognised for his pioneering work with tribal and rural communities in Karnataka. In 1984, he founded the Swami Vivekananda Youth Movement (SVYM), a development organisation whose interventions in health, education, livelihoods, and community empowerment reach over three million people. In 2011, he founded the Grassroots Research and Advocacy Movement (GRAAM) to bridge the gap between grassroots realities and public policy through evidence-based research and advocacy. 

Prior to joining NITI Aayog, he served as Member (Human Resources) of the Capacity Building Commission from April 2021 to April 2026, where he played a key role in advancing civil services capacity building and public sector human resource reforms. He was the Frank H. T. Rhodes Professor at Cornell University, USA, from 2012 to 2014, and continued his association with Cornell University as a Visiting Professor and Faculty Affiliate until 2024. 

Dr. Balu holds a PhD in Leadership and Management. He was awarded the Doctor of Letters (Honoris Causa) by Nrupatunga University, Government of Karnataka, in recognition of his contributions to social development and his work with rural and tribal communities. 

He earned a Master of Public Administration from John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University where he was a Mason Fellow. He also holds an MPhil in Hospital and Health Systems Management and an MBBS. His academic background reflects an interdisciplinary foundation spanning medicine, public administration, systems management, leadership, and social development.

name: Suresh Bhojraj
company: JSS Academy of Higher Education and Research, Mysuru
bio: Dr. B. Suresh Bhojraj is Pro-Chancellor of JSS University and JSS Academy of Higher Education & Research (JSS AHER), and Director of the Technical Education Division of JSS Mahavidyapeetha. Under his leadership, JSS institutions have become centres of excellence. He transformed pharmacy education in India by driving the introduction of the Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) programme, aligning it with global standards.
bio_full_text:
Professional Profile – Dr. B. Suresh Bhojraj 
Comprehensive Professional Profile 
 
Dr. B. Suresh Bhojraj is an eminent academic leader, visionary institution builder, and 
global advocate for quality, ethics, and innovation in pharmacy and higher education. 
With a distinguished career spanning over four decades, he has been instrumental in 
shaping the future of health sciences education and research in India and abroad. 
 
He currently serves as the Pro-Chancellor of JSS University, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, JSS 
Academy of Higher Education & Research (JSS AHER), Mysuru, Karnataka,  and the 
Director of the Technical Education Division of JSS Mahavidyapeetha, Mysuru — one of 
India’s largest educational networks. Under his strategic leadership, JSS institutions 
have emerged as centers of excellence in multidisciplinary education, research, and 
innovation, with a global presence across Mauritius, Dubai, and the United States. 
 
A former President of the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), Dr. Suresh played a 
transformative role in modernizing pharmacy education and regulation. He was the 
driving force behind the introduction of the Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) program in 
India — a milestone that integrated clinical pharmacy into the nation’s healthcare 
system. His leadership redefined the academic and professional landscape of 
pharmacy education, aligning it with international standards and patient-centric 
practice. 
 
On the global stage, Dr. Suresh has served with the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP) and 
worked closely with the Accreditation Council for Pharmacy Education (ACPE), 
contributing to global educational reforms, harmonization of standards, and capacity-
building across continents. His thought leadership has earned him recognition as a key 
voice in advancing pharmaceutical quality, regulatory science, and professional ethics. 
 
He has been a member and advisor to several national and international scientific 
bodies, steering initiatives in research, innovation, and policy development. His 
dynamic vision has led to the establishment of Centers of Excellence in frontier areas 
such as space technology applications, artificial intelligence, molecular modeling, 
quantum computing, and EV mobility, through collaborations with ISRO, DRDO, DST, 
DBT, and global universities. 
 
Dr. Suresh is a mentor to a generation of educators, researchers, and health 
professionals, known for his transformative leadership philosophy — “From Healer to 
Leader.” His approach blends science and spirituality, fostering leadership rooted in 
compassion, purpose, and service. 

 
An inspiring orator and author, he is frequently invited to speak at national and 
international forums, where he articulates his vision for a world where education, 
innovation, and ethics converge to serve humanity. 
Dr. Suresh Bhojraj continues to inspire a global movement in healthcare education — 
empowering the next generation of professionals to lead with knowledge, humility, and 
vision.

name: Nidhi Goyal
bio: Ms Nidhi Goyal, COO at Tata Indian Institute of Skills, leverages over 20 years of experience in institution building and education. She led the establishment and launch of IIS Mumbai and Ahmedabad, developing high-quality, industry-aligned skilling programmes focused on workforce development. Her passion lies in developing practical pedagogical interventions for excellence in training.
bio_full_text:
Ms Nidhi Goyal, COO at Tata Indian Institute of Skills, brings 20+ years of experience across Financial 
Services, IT, and Higher Education sectors. She spent her early career at American Express, where she 
led internal consulting projects in strategy and business transformation, and grew quickly to become 
the India head of the premium Charge card products, New product development and strategic 
partnerships. She was recognized as an Economic Times Young Leader in India, the only woman to 
make it to the inaugural list. 
Driven by a desire to create impact through her work, she moved out of the corporate world in 2017 
to establish India's first design-centric university, Anant National University, in Ahmedabad under the 
leadership of Dr. Ajay Piramal. At Anant, she pushed the boundaries of design education by 
establishing an innovative multi-disciplinary curriculum and choice-based credit system enabling 
greater flexibility and informed decision making for students. She was instrumental in setting up the 
Centre for Sustainability while also building strong marketing, admissions and corporate relations 
teams.  
With her experience and expertise in institution building and developing high performing teams, she 
has led the establishment and launch of IIS Mumbai and IIS Ahmedabad and devised strategies to 
offer high-quality, industry-aligned skilling programs that cater to the diverse needs of students and 
the Indian workforce. Her passion lies in developing practical pedagogical interventions for 
excellence in training and education.  
She is also an advisor and mentor to various social enterprises and startups.  
By way of education, she is a mechanical engineer from NIT Allahabad and completed her MBA from 
IIM Calcutta. Ms Goyal resides in Ahmedabad with her very supportive husband and two children, 
who inspire her to embrace the values of unconditional giving.
